hadith:
Shortening the Prayers (At-Taqseer) - Narrated Salim bin `Abdullah:

Ibn `Umar said, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to pray the Nawafil on the back of his Mount (carriage) by signs facing any direction." Ibn `Umar used to do the same.
message:
Based on these teachings, here is a message of spiritual guidance:

Allah commands us to treat others with kindness and fairness, regardless of differences, reminding us that compassion is a cornerstone of faith. Through understanding Al-Jabbaar, The Compeller, we recognize that Allah alone holds supreme power to restore justice and order in all matters, which should inspire us to trust in His divine plan while fulfilling our own responsibility to act justly toward others. Let this knowledge strengthen your heart to be merciful and fair in all dealings, knowing that Allah loves those who embody these noble qualities.
name:
Al Jabbaar - الْجَبَّارُ - The Compeller

Al Jabbaar, meaning 'The Compeller' or 'The Restorer', reflects Allah's supreme ability to enforce His will upon creation. It emphasizes His power to rectify and restore all that is broken or unjust. This name highlights Allah's dominion over the universe, ensuring that justice and order prevail according to His divine plan.
verse:
Al-Mumtahanah - She that is to be examined - 60:8

Allah does not forbid you from dealing kindly and fairly with those who have neither fought nor driven you out of your homes. Surely Allah loves those who are fair.
